Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner reversed the age comparison. Despite finding that Lyudmil Kirkov was born in 1933 and William Witney in 1915, they concluded that Kirkov (and thus The Boy Turns Man) had the older director. Since 1915 < 1933, William Witney is older, so A Strange Adventure should have been the correct answer.
